text:
Apropos of the syphon, we may mention a very simple application of the principle. Cut off a strip of cloth, and arrange it so that one end shall remain in a glass of water while the other hangs down. In a short time the water from the upper glass will have passed through the cloth-fibres to the lower one.

Gaston Tissandier, Popular Scientific Recreations, English edition.
